ops.title: Pack .claude/settings.json whenever the inventory pins Claude plugins (ref-only marketplaces)

ops.text: render.go includes the .claude/settings.json copy tree for any inventory with Claude plugins, branch marketplace or not
a render_test case with plugins and only ref marketplaces asserts the settings tree is present in HomeTrees and in the pack_path list
the next payload is rebuilt from the head containing this fix, and a fresh create on a stock Sprite reports every pin enabled with zero errors
